content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - prod warmup failures (us-west-2) — spike of OOMs, CUDA errors, and a few container restarts during model warmup. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-warmup

jamie: noticed a flurry of OOMKilled on gpu-node-87 while xxl-1.2b was initializing. Also seeing driver warnings.

nisha: pulling the node logs now, past minute shows repeated allocation failures and a deserialize error on artifact shard 7.

nisha: logs paste:
```
[2026-03-15T04:45:12Z] runtime: warmup allocate kv_cache 14.0GB -> FAIL: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-15T04:45:13Z] kernel: cuCtxSynchronize: driver lost? ret=719
[2026-03-15T04:45:14Z] kubelet: container "runtime-model" terminated with exit code 137 (OOMKilled)
[2026-03-15T04:45:15Z] deserialiser: shard 7 checksum mismatch: expected ab12.. got 00ff..
[2026-03-15T04:45:16Z] compile: kernel compile exceeded 2m, canceling
```

rachel: I saw a model-store publish for xxl-1.2b-qk at 04:30Z. Could be a bad artifact or partial push.

jamie: immediate mitigations suggestion: 1) flip warmup off for xxl-1.2b in prod 2) shift some traffic to xxl-1.2b-smaller (fallback) 3) cordon gpu-node-87 and evacuate pods 4) force artifact verify/pull for shards with checksum issues

ops-runner: executing safe mitigations now. I will put a 20% traffic weight on fallback and disable warmup flag.

ops-runner: commands:
```bash
redwoodctl feature-set set warmup.enabled xxl-1.2b false --env prod
redwoodctl route update xxl-1.2b --split "xxl-1.2b:80,xxl-1.2b-smaller:20" --env prod
kubectl --context=prod cordon gpu-node-87 && kubectl drain gpu-node-87 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

nisha: after changes, OOMs dropped dramatically. fallback variant handling looks healthy. A small number of pods still failing because they pulled bad shard 7.

jamie: ops-runner, force artifact refresh for shard 7 and 8 from model-store with verify flag. bump compile timeout to 300s for this model so the longer compile doesn't get cut off while we stabilize.

ops-runner: running:
```bash
redwoodctl models refresh-artifact xxl-1.2b --shard 7 --force --verify --env prod
redwoodctl config set runtime.compile_timeout 300 --model xxl-1.2b --env prod
```

nisha: refresh succeeded, checksums now match on previously failing nodes. two pods finished warmup and transitioned to ready. compile time increased but completed.

sara: customer impact: 1.8% 5xxs in us-west-2 during the event window, highest error rate at ~04:46Z. Affected accounts: acct-dataflow (high latency), beta-internal (intermittent failures). No request payloads leaked. CS and account owners notified, holding on broader customer note until rollback audit completes.

jamie: good. I'm logging an action: audit recent model-store pushes (last 6h) for any incomplete uploads or checksum mismatches. If >0.5% shards fail verification, we need to roll back the publish.

leo: I'll take the handoff for incident coordination and post-incident steps. leo: summary to me: warmup triggered large allocation then GPU OOM -> container OOMKilled -> some shards had checksum mismatches from a model-store publish -> compile timeouts compounded. Mitigations applied: warmup disabled, partial traffic shift to fallback, node evacuated, artifact re-verified, compile timeout increased.

leo: assigning owners: @nisha perform full checksum sweep across production shards (24h), @rachel investigate model-store publish pipeline and retry logic, @ops-runner prepare rollback runbook if needed, @sara finalize customer comms.

nisha: starting checksum sweep: ~1500 shards to validate across regions. ETA ~35m. posting progress in ~30m.

rachel: I'll check CI for the publish that made it through at 04:30Z and look for transient storage issues or interrupted uploads.

ops-runner: prepared rollback plan (dry-run) and will only execute with leo + infra sign-off.

incident-bot: page reassigned to leo per on-call handoff.

leo: leaving channel for the incident log; will update once audit completes or if rollback is required. next update in 45m or on any customer-impact change. :white_check_mark:
